product: Replogle Odessa 12" Illuminated Desk Globe - Blue Ocean & Raised Relief

entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for talking with me: the reward is $35 off. To unlock your code, you need to say at least 1,200 words on this call: the "Your words" bar at the bottom of your screen counts them. You can stop whenever you like, but it only unlocks once you reach that. I see you were looking at the Odessa 12 inch Illuminated Desk Globe. It's sold out right now. What were you hoping it would do for you?
Happy to help. I'd love to hear what you were hoping the Odessa globe would bring to your space. Was it for a desk at home, an office, or maybe a gift?
I'm interested in buying a globe from Replogle I'm wondering if you can tell me a little bit about the quality of the globes. And how long they last.

The Odessa page describes a weighty die-cast metal base, raised-relief maps, and a build meant to last as an heirloom. I don't have an exact lifespan figure, so I won't guess. When you picture the metal parts, are you worried they might feel cheap or look like plastic?
